summary: Partial fix: ordinary denoising requests can resolve promoted regional plans and uncovered requests fall back eagerly, and unsupported tensor metrics now fail closed. The stateful CausalDMD/LingBot production forward path never invokes request-time plan resolution, and no real offline full-trajectory validation/adaptor flow produces manifests.

tests.what_was_measured: Candidate regression suite: 22 tests passed, including resolver mismatch fallback, regional wrapper deactivation/reactivation, trajectory structural/numerical checks, and fail-closed unsupported tensor metrics.

tests.command: AST inspection of CausalDMDDenoisingStage.forward on exact candidate
tests.what_was_measured: Independent adversarial production-path check: the stateful causal forward override calls neither _resolve_compile_plan nor _maybe_enable_cache_dit_and_torch_compile.
ROCm/Inductor Linear-tanh toy: four-step eager/compiled parity, warm/reset-short-history behavior, and intentional perturbation rejection; not a production model qualification.
Original feature absence: compile_trajectory.py absent and causal request path has no trajectory-plan resolution.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. Toy maximum absolute error 1.1920928955078125e-07; perturbation rejected. No production model weights were available.

remaining_counterexamples: CausalDMDDenoisingStage.forward, the stateful base used by LingBot-World, never resolves or applies a manifest-backed compile plan; configured manifests cause initialization compilation to be deferred, so matching stateful requests remain eager.
No non-test caller captures and evaluates a complete eager-versus-compiled trajectory or writes a validated manifest, so the proposed promotion flow is not operational.

No real diffusion or stateful world-model trajectory qualifies history/shape regimes, cache on/off, CFG serial/parallel, reset isolation, mutation/alias metadata, semantic output metrics, or distributed topology.
remaining_limitations: No production diffusion or LingBot-World weights and no promoted production manifests were available.
The GPU exercise is a deterministic Linear/tanh toy and cannot establish model semantic accuracy or state/cache safety.
Only one AMD Instinct MI355X was available; distributed and non-ROCm architectures were not tested.
No native source changed and repository-environment.json reports no native component, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
Torch emitted non-fatal Dynamo metrics JSON-serialization errors during the successful toy compilation run.
